{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yin Wood Rooster''' (乙酉, ''kinoto tori''; onyomi ''otsuyu'') is the 22nd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 22nd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Wood Monkey|ja|甲申}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Fire Dog|ja|丙戌}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''乙'' is Yin Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''酉'' (Rooster) is Yin Metal; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Wood Rooster (乙酉)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): yǐyǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jyut3 jau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoto-tori
*** On'yomi: otsuyu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): eul-yu (을유)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Ất Dậu

==Months of Yin Wood Rooster==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|August|en|August|qid=Q122|lt=August}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Wood Rooster|ja|乙酉|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsuyuu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew}} until the day before {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Lesser Cold}}) as applicable.
